one_liner: Ranks every number by the chance, learned from the last 208 draws, that a number absent for as long as it has been comes up next.
registry_status_reason: Released by package REL-1 (releases and WF-1 design v0.1r1, owner decisions WF1-1 and WF1-2, ratified 31 October 2026). Contract runs on real data need the separate real-development gate.
short_explanation: E_17 looks at how long each number has been away since it was last drawn. It groups absences into seven lengths and estimates, over all the numbers together and over the last 208 draws, how often a number absent for each length came up at the next draw, pulled towards the fair rate by 100 fair draws. Each number scores the estimate for its present absence. It ranks the numbers by that value: its top pick is the highest-ranked numbers and its inverse pick the lowest-ranked, with exact ties settled by the project tie rule (TIE_SHA256_V1). Its scores are not chances, so no probabilities are published. It uses only which numbers were drawn, not their order or the dates, and needs 208 earlier draws. If the draws are fair, it is not expected to beat chance.
